empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.body: Connect a Facebook Page or an Instagram account to start posting from here.
empty.readOnlyBody: An admin of this workspace connects accounts. Once they do, they appear here.

login.nothingAdded: Nothing added from this login yet.

chooser.title: Connect an account
chooser.description: Choose where you want to post.
chooser.noneEnabled: No networks are set up on this server yet. Whoever runs it adds each network’s app keys first.
chooser.loadError: The list of networks didn’t load.
chooser.loginTitle: How do you want to sign in?
chooser.loginDescription: {{network}} accounts can be reached two ways.

facebook.label: Continue with Facebook
facebook.description: For Instagram business accounts linked to a Facebook Page. One sign-in adds your Pages and their Instagram accounts.

instagram.label: Continue with Instagram
instagram.description: For Instagram professional accounts that aren’t linked to a Page.

chooser.tip: {{provider}} signs you in as whoever is logged in to {{provider}} in this browser. To add a different account, sign out of {{provider}} first, or open Socioboard in a private window.

picker.title: Add accounts
picker.alreadyConnected: {{name}} is already connected. To add a different {{provider}} account, sign out of {{provider}} in this browser (or use a private window), then connect again.
picker.reconnected: Reconnected {{name}}’s {{provider}} login. Its accounts can post again.
picker.movesHere: Added through {{name}}’s login. Adding it here moves it to this login.

unavailable.not_professional: Only professional (business or creator) Instagram accounts can post. Switch it to one in the Instagram app, then connect again.
unavailable.missing_permission: Socioboard wasn’t given access to this one. Reconnect and allow it.

picker.allAdded: Everything this login can post to is already added.
picker.nothingBody: This {{provider}} login doesn’t manage any Pages or professional accounts that Socioboard can post to. Check its access on {{provider}}, or connect a different account.
picker.loadError: What this login can post to didn’t load.
picker.networkDown: {{provider}} didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.
picker.needsReconnect: {{provider}} no longer accepts this login. Reconnect it to continue.

connectError.title: {{provider}} didn’t connect
connectError.ACCESS_DENIED: The sign-in was cancelled, so nothing was connected.
connectError.OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: That sign-in link expired or was already used. Start again from here.
connectError.RECONNECT_WRONG_ACCOUNT: You signed in as a different person than the login you’re reconnecting. Sign in as the same person, or connect this one as a new login.
connectError.MISSING_PERMISSIONS: Some permissions Socioboard needs to post weren’t allowed. Connect again and keep every option switched on.
connectError.NETWORK_NOT_ENABLED: This network isn’t set up on this server.
connectError.NETWORK_ERROR: The network didn’t answer as expected. Try again in a moment.

details.title: Account details
details.disconnectPending_one: {{count}} scheduled post to it will be cancelled.
details.disconnectPending_other: {{count}} scheduled posts to it will be cancelled.
details.disconnectHistory: Its post history stays, and it comes back if you connect it again.

loginDetails.title: {{provider}} login
loginDetails.removeBody_one: Its {{count}} account is disconnected and its scheduled posts are cancelled.
loginDetails.removeBody_other: Its {{count}} accounts are disconnected and their scheduled posts are cancelled.
loginDetails.removeHistory: Post history stays. You can connect the login again later.
